decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing control elements and resource management to maintain board advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes powerful cards like Force of Negation, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Force of Will to counter and remove threats. The presence of Lórien Revealed and Leyline Binding suggests a focus on enchantment-based disruption. The deck also incorporates card draw and selection with Brainstorm and Ponder. Additionally, it incorporates graveyard recursion with Life from the Loam and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. The deck's mana base is carefully designed to provide the necessary colors and includes utility lands like Mystic Sanctuary and Wasteland.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to apply pressure on the opponent with efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland while also gaining card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm. By efficiently utilizing its resources, the deck seeks to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept behind this deck is to aggressively deploy Arclight Phoenix, a powerful and resilient creature that can be brought back from the graveyard. The deck achieves this by employing a combination of cheap, efficient spells like Gut Shot and Lightning Bolt to trigger the Phoenix's ability, as well as card draw and manipulation spells such as Brainstorm and Faithless Looting to ensure a steady stream of spells to cast. Additionally, the deck includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its key threats.

The main focus of this deck is to establish a strong control over the game by utilizing powerful instant spells and creatures to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan. Using cards like Brainstorm, Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to manipulate the board state and counter threats efficiently. The inclusion of Orcish Bowmasters and Staff of the Storyteller provides additional control options and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents through strategic plays and careful resource management.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures to apply pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan. The key concept revolves around a combination of powerful creatures like Grief, Murktide Regent, Orcish Bowmasters, and Troll of Khazad-dûm, along with a suite of disruptive and interactive spells like Brainstorm, Daze, Force of Will, and Fatal Push. The deck also incorporates a reanimation package with cards like Reanimate and Sheoldred's Edict to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to quickly establish board presence, disrupt the opponent's plan, and maintain control throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize artifacts, specifically blue artifacts, in an aggressive strategy. It includes cards like Mox Opal, Karn, the Great Creator, and Chalice of the Void to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also focuses on card advantage and disruption, with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Force of Will. The deck has a heavy artifact theme, with cards like Urza's Saga and Saprazzan Skerry providing additional resources. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build a powerful board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells and removal spells, such as Force of Negation, Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Lórien Revealed. It also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Pithing Needle and Soul-Guide Lantern. The deck relies on the powerful card advantage engine provided by Standstill and Urza's Saga to generate card advantage and stall the game. Lastly, it has a win condition in the form of Shark Typhoon and potentially Timeless Dragon and March of Otherworldly Light.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly get powerful creatures into the graveyard, then bring them back to the battlefield using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By utilizing cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting, the deck aims to consistently put high-impact creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into play early in the game. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Unmask to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect the combo. Overall, the deck is focused on fast-paced reanimation strategies to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and the mechanic of cascading spells. The key strategy is to use cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into impactful spells like Crashing Footfalls, which create a swarm of creatures. The deck includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Mystical Dispute to protect its own game plan. Additionally, the deck leverages mana acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Elvish Spirit Guide to cast its spells ahead of schedule. The land base includes a mix of Fetchlands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana fixing.

The focus of this deck is to quickly combo off using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill your library, while also generating advantage with cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga. Thassa's Oracle serves as the win condition to finish the game once your library is depleted. Key components include protection spells like Force of Will, disruption with Cabal Therapy, and card selection tools like Brainstorm and Ponder. By assembling the combo pieces efficiently and protecting your plan, this deck aims to win through a decisive combo finish.

The deck revolves around using Cephalid Illusionist in combination with Nomads en-Kor to mill the library quickly and efficiently, while also generating creatures like Narcomoeba. This allows for quick graveyard filling to eventually win the game with a combo involving Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return. The deck includes various protection spells like Force of Will and Daze, as well as card draw and manipulation with Brainstorm and Ponder. Urza's Saga and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional utility and value in the deck's game plan. Retrofitter Foundry and Lórien Revealed offer alternative win conditions for the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to use the card Doomsday to set up a winning combination, typically involving Thassa's Oracle and a way to draw cards. The deck includes a variety of ways to filter through the deck, protect the combo with counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, and generate mana quickly with cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual. The goal is to set up a winning sequence of cards to win the game in a single turn.

The primary focus of this Doomsday combo deck is to quickly assemble the necessary cards to win the game using the Doomsday spell. This involves setting up a specific sequence of cards in the deck to ensure a successful win condition, often relying on efficient mana production and disruption to protect the combo. The deck also includes cards to help dig through the deck and find key pieces, as well as interaction to disrupt opponents and prevent them from interfering with the combo plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill your opponent's deck out quickly. The deck includes cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to help search for and recur key pieces of the combo, while also running disruption cards like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to protect your combo. With access to powerful mana acceleration through cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and win the game in a swift fashion.

Fast-paced gameplay with cheap threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by countermagic and burn spells to control the board and finish off the opponent quickly. Murktide Regent provides a powerful late-game threat, while True-Name Nemesis is difficult to deal with for many opponents. Mishra's Bauble helps to set up Delirium for Dragon's Rage Channeler and fuels Unholy Heat. Efficient cantrips like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Preordain ensure consistent card selection and mana efficiency. Wasteland is included for additional disruption to slow down the opponent.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through counter spells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Narset and Teferi. The deck includes a mix of card draw, removal, and board wipes to answer various threats while also having access to powerful sideboard options like Blood Moon and Dress Down for additional disruption. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells of different colors. This deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and grind out incremental advantage to secure victory.
